en: Hetuduka, Kusalattika (The Couple of Causes, The Triplet of the Wholesome)
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
Conditioned by a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, a state that is root and wholesome arises by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, a state that is neither-root and wholesome arises by way of root-condition. Conditioned by a state that is neither-root nor wholesome...
Conditioned by wholesome states that are roots and wholesome states that are not roots, wholesome states arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three;
... up to ... under non-disappearance there are three.

Conditioned by a state that is not a root and is unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is a root arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... up to ... under non-disappearance there are three.
Dependent on a non-root, indeterminate state, a non-root, indeterminate state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-non-root, indeterminate state, a non-root, indeterminate state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both a non-root, indeterminate state and a non-non-root, indeterminate state, a non-root, indeterminate state [arises].
It arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three for the root condition, three for the predominance condition …pe… three for the non-disappearance condition.
